res-process-wide-state-and-threads
text:
- **Process-wide state and threads:** Stylo's global rayon pool under `StyleThreading::Parallel` (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:20-21; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:156-164); document ids from a static `AtomicUsize` starting at 1 (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:417-419); request ids from a static `AtomicUsize` (packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:88-90); a `thread_local!` `LAYOUT_CTX` per thread (packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:17-19); static `FONT_DB` under `svg` (packages/blitz-dom/src/util.rs:46-51); Android `OnceLock` `ANDROID_APP` (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:69-85); thread `blitz-vibey-script-timers` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/document.rs:353-356); log target `js_console` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:36); in both binaries of the seven_guis package — `seven_guis_native` and the driver's command line and session host `escher-session`, its second install site (examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:30) — `escher_telemetry::init` installs the global `tracing` default subscriber, the `log` → `tracing` bridge (`tracing_log::LogTracer`) and a chaining panic hook, records the first install in a static `OnceLock<ServiceIdentity>` behind a static `Mutex<()>` init lock, emits at log targets `escher_telemetry` and `escher_telemetry::panic`, and spawns no thread (examples/seven_guis/src/main.rs:6-9; packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:96-97; packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:144-161; packages/escher-telemetry/src/panic.rs:4-24); log target `escher_driver`, under which escher-driver's command span is emitted at INFO since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans and its `tool_call` span since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface
 — admitted by the sink's `escher_` prefix and written only in a process that has a sink installed at `info` or below: the two re-run children of `stand_act_spans` and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, an `escher-session` host, which runs each hosted call through `Session::run` under its installed sink — one closed-span line per call, 3 lines for 3 calls in `host_log` at `trace`, with 0 id needles, 0 name needles and 0 occurrences of a typed sentinel on the host's stderr under both builds, and since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface the `escher-session mcp` role — one `tool_call` line per tool call and a `command` line per instance call it runs through `Session::run`, 5 and 3 over one CRUD flow at `info`, with 0 id needles, 0 name needles and 0 occurrences of a typed sentinel at `trace` under both builds (`mcp_log`); `seven_guis_native` installs the sink and runs no command (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:106; packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:118-121; examples/seven_guis/tests/mcp_log.rs:51-266; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md, the host's lines at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md); 64 event-handler count slots indexed by `DomEventKind` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:22-23; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:36); wasm32 browser `setTimeout` callbacks for resize settling (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:530-547); WPT spawns `git rev-parse HEAD` in WPT_DIR and the current directory (wpt/runner/src/report.rs:11-24; wpt/runner/src/report.rs:31-32); `scripts/cold-agent.sh run` spawns one `claude` client (the Claude Code CLI) per run, which spawns `sh` → `escher-session mcp --record target/cold-agent/record` (`target/debug/escher-session`, `RUST_LOG=info` set on that child only, its stderr to `target/cold-agent/server.log`) connected over stdio only
 — since 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test, in place of `python3 cold_agent_stub.py`; the pipe's judge then spawns two `escher-session mcp` replay children directly, without `--record` (stderr to `/dev/null`), one for the full replay of the agent's check and one for the ablated replay, every reply bounded at 30 s (`REPLY_BOUND`), each killed and reaped — that replay crossing on the founder's «Один запуск, до $3 (Рекомендую)» and «JSON-проверка с повтором (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-15, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option labels; the English wording is the overseer's; confirmed at that chunk's wrap card, «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)»); the run ends them all, no listener, port or socket is added, and the client's own local messaging socket is the client's, opened by no escher code (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-06) (scripts/cold-agent.sh:580-584; scripts/cold-agent.sh:297-336; scripts/cold-agent.sh:339-356; scripts/cold-agent.sh:371-395; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-cold-agent-run-pipe/report.md and escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-15-cold-agent-test/report.md); five blitz-tests integration binaries re-execute their own test binary under `cargo test`, the first three once each and the fourth and fifth twice — since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot `stand_screenshot_repeat` runs `std::env::current_exe()` twice with a fixed argv, each child running its ignored `child_prints_its_shots` and printing its shots to stdout, which the parent captures and reads into its assertions only (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_screenshot_repeat.rs:75-98;
 tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_screenshot_repeat.rs:139-146), and `telemetry_stdout_silent` runs `std::env::current_exe()` with `--ignored --exact child_emits --nocapture`, its output captured and `RUST_LOG` removed from the child's env, `telemetry_drop` runs it with the same argv, its output captured and `RUST_LOG=warn,style=trace,dioxus_core=trace,selectors=trace` set on the child, which installs the sink with `init`, and `stand_id_persistence` runs it with `--ignored --exact ids_in_a_child_process --nocapture`, its output captured, setting or removing no env var, and `stand_act_spans` runs it with `--ignored --exact {child} --nocapture` on each of its two ignored children, its output captured, `RUST_LOG=info` set on one child and `RUST_LOG` removed from the other, each child installing the sink with `init_with_writer` over an in-memory capture — test-only, a fixed argv, no socket or port (tests/blitz-tests/tests/telemetry_stdout_silent.rs:10-14; tests/blitz-tests/tests/telemetry_drop.rs:14-22; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_id_persistence.rs:290-300; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_spans.rs:569-577; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-id-persistence/report.md, `telemetry_drop` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/report.md, `stand_act_spans` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md); two more re-execute it as a session host — `stand_session_lifecycle` on each of its two ignored children, `--ignored --exact session_host --nocapture` serving under `IDLE_EXPIRY` and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, `session_host_with_a_short_expiry` serving under a short expiry while the parent watches the state directory go, their streams sent to null, and `stand_session_quiet` with `--ignored --exact session_host_with_typed_text --nocapture`, its streams captured and `RUST_LOG=trace` set on the child
 — each child an `#[ignore]` test that serves one session on its Unix-domain socket in a state directory under `target/tmp/` until it is stopped or idle for its expiry, every wait of the parent bounded and a guard killing and reaping a host a failing check still holds; and eight seven_guis test targets spawn the built `escher-session` binary through `CARGO_BIN_EXE_escher-session` — `host_binary`, and `host_log` on `crud` and on `cells` (its paged part read: a sentinel committed into a part-2 cell, then `snapshot --part 2`; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:134-277) with `RUST_LOG=trace`, spawn the host role themselves, both streams piped and drained from the spawn on by one thread of the test process each, the session reached by `attach` polled under a 60 s bound, stopped by `stop` and its exit waited for under a 10 s bound; since 2026-10-10-driver-cli `host_timer` does the same on `timer`, `cli_commands` runs the binary once per command as a client, its sessions started by the binary's own `start` command, as `host_log`'s unix-only recording-clients check does too — `start crud --record` through `stop`, each run at `RUST_LOG=trace`, in `hl-client` and `hl-client-rec`, a `Started` guard stopping the session (examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:42-132) —
 and `cli_flow` runs the two flow scripts of `tests/flows/` under plain `sh`, each script running the binary once per step, and since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface `mcp_server` and `mcp_log` spawn its `mcp` role as a child spoken to over piped stdin, and `recording` does both, with `--record`, and runs `tests/flows/record_checks.sh` under `sh` into `rc-fresh`, both streams drained, a `Started` guard and the bounded run's 90 s, comparing both recorded files byte for byte with the committed copies — the eight sharing the helpers of `examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs`: the kill-and-reap guard, the stream drain, one bounded run of the binary as a client, a guard that stops a started session and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, `Speaker`, which reads the child's stdout line by line on one thread under a 30 s reply bound and kills and reaps the child in its `Drop` (examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:203-211; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:332-337; tests/blitz-tests/tests/session_common/mod.rs:344-408;
 tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_session_lifecycle.rs:239-255; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_session_quiet.rs:102-115; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_binary.rs:16; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:24; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:303-322; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:35-44; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-session/report.md, `host_log` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/report.md); the `escher-session` host itself is one process holding one session and one listener on its main thread, spawning no thread of its own — serving `load`, the stand's `LoadNet` spawns one per fetch (below) —, started by whoever runs it (`escher_driver::start` spawns the caller's `std::process::Command`) or, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, by the binary's own `start` command — which spawns the running binary again (`std::env::current_exe()`) as `serve <task> --session <dir>`, with `--record <dir>` after it when it was given one, with stdin, stdout and stderr closed, waits up to 30 s for the host to answer and drops the handle, neither killing nor reaping it — and ended by `stop` or by its idle expiry, 1,800 s with no answered request (examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:8-58; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:456-476); since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface the binary's `mcp` role is one process holding at most one session in process, with no listener and no thread of its own — under a `start load` the stand's `LoadNet` spawns one per fetch; its idle expiry checked when a request arrives — started by the MCP client that spawns it, its stderr the binary's `escher_telemetry::init` sink, a third role reaching that one install site (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:44-112; packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:140-147)

subject: res-process-wide-state-and-threads
text: - `static PARALLEL_TRAVERSAL_LOCK: Mutex<()>` in blitz-dom's `stylo.rs`, process-wide: taken around every `StyleThreading::Parallel` traversal, so two documents resolving `Parallel` at once on Stylo's global rayon pool are serialised and no longer panic `already mutably borrowed` (blitz issue 430); its poison recovered by `unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())`, with no panic path and no log site; `Sequential` stays the default, and `Parallel` is set by the windowed `dioxus_native::launch` (`seven_guis_native`) and the browser's document loader and toolbar, by no headless document — harness, stand or driver (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:29-35; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:157-163; packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:63; packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:222; apps/browser/src/document_loader.rs:62; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:203).

subject: res-environment-variables
text: - **Environment variables:** `RUST_LOG`, the tracing filter directives `escher_telemetry::init` reads through `EnvFilter::try_from_default_env`, defaulting to `warn` when unset or unparsable (packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:144), and which the upstream `tracing_subscriber::fmt::init()` installs also read under `tracing` (apps/browser/src/main.rs:73-74; apps/readme/src/main.rs:76-77; examples/todomvc/src/main.rs:16-17); `WPT_DIR` (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:472-478); `PAINT_TREE_BENCH_HTML` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_tree_bench.rs:258-269); `MULTI_DOC_N` (a count, parsed with a default fallback; examples/multi_doc.rs:55-58), `MULTI_DOC_SEQ` (sequential style threading; examples/multi_doc.rs:36-40) and `MULTI_DOC_FLAT` (examples/multi_doc.rs:22), the last two through its `env_flag` (examples/multi_doc.rs:17-19), read by the root example `multi_doc` alone, no library or escher binary reading them; `TMPDIR`, through `std::env::temp_dir()` — on unix that variable, else `/tmp` — in escher-driver's unix-only client unit test, to place its test-only listener's directory, test code only (packages/escher-driver/src/client.rs:263-308; since 2026-10-14-quality-gates); `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `PR_NUMBER`, `RUN_URL` defaults and `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` in the CI script (.github/scripts/wpt_diff_to_pr.py:274-280; .github/scripts/wpt_diff_to_pr.py:293-308)

subject: crosscut-config-management
text: - **Config management:** documents are configured through the `DocumentConfig` struct (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:29-72); optional capabilities are compile-time Cargo features, each dioxus-native feature forwarding to the same-named feature of the underlying blitz crates, and `accessibility` also to `dioxus-native-dom/accessibility`, which enables dioxus-native-dom's own optional `accesskit` and gates its `accessibility_tree` override and its `snapshot`, `snapshot_diff`, `snapshot_text` and `actionable` modules (packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml:16-33; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:15-23; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:41), with feature-gated code in the apps (apps/browser/src/main.rs:23-24; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:215-258; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:278-312); launch configs are `Box<dyn Any>` values downcast at launch (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:115-146); platform behavior is gated with `cfg(target_os = ...)` and an `IS_MOBILE` const (apps/browser/src/main.rs:48; apps/browser/src/main.rs:79-89; apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:9-12); on `wasm32` system-font discovery is disabled and `build_single_font_ctx` is the standard WASM setup (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:434-437; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:134-139); runtime inputs are CLI arguments and environment variables (see Occupied Resources)

subject: crosscut-logging-and-timing
text:
- **Logging and timing:** `tracing`, `tracing-subscriber` and `tracing-log` are workspace dependencies (Cargo.toml:188-190); escher binaries install `escher_telemetry::init(escher_telemetry::service_identity!())` at start — today the two binaries of the seven_guis package, which therefore both stamp `service.name=seven_guis`: `seven_guis_native`, unconditionally on the native target, before `dioxus_native::launch`, and the session host `escher-session`, first thing in its native `main`, each reporting an `Err` with `eprintln!` and continuing (examples/seven_guis/src/main.rs:4-10; examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:30-32) — which builds a `Registry` with an `EnvFilter` and one non-ANSI fmt layer using the escher formatter (tracing-subscriber features env-filter · fmt · registry · std · tracing-log) — stated once, in the private `sink_layer`, which since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans sets `with_span_events(FmtSpan::CLOSE)` and the crate-private field formatter `SpanFields`, so the layer prints a closed span's line beside an event's (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-09 — §Standard Contracts → Telemetry bootstrap) — writes to stderr only, stamps `service.name` / `service.version` on every line, bridges `log` records, drops every record whose target is outside the engine and escher prefix sets (`ENGINE_TARGET_PREFIXES`, `ESCHER_TARGET_PREFIXES`) at every level and whatever `RUST_LOG` names, scrubs the records that print — a closed span's fields by the rule that judges an event's — and chains the panic hook — no filter layer is added, the drop sits in the formatter (packages/escher-telemetry/Cargo.toml:13-16; packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:102-163; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:134-178);
 escher-driver emits its command span and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, its `tool_call` span through `tracing` ungated and installs no subscriber (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:96-111); the upstream `tracing_subscriber::fmt::init()` installs run only under the `tracing` feature and write to stdout unscrubbed (apps/browser/src/main.rs:73-74; apps/readme/src/main.rs:76-77; examples/todomvc/src/main.rs:16-17); tracing is an optional feature forwarded down the crate chain (packages/blitz-html/Cargo.toml:15; packages/blitz-net/Cargo.toml:18; packages/blitz-paint/Cargo.toml:15; packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:21; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/document.rs:265-266; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1104-1105; packages/blitz/src/lib.rs:48-49); the WPT runner uses the `log` facade with `env_logger::init()` (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:26; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:467; wpt/runner/src/net_provider.rs:3); frame and phase time logging are opt-in features `log-frame-times`, `log-phase-times` (Cargo.toml:265-268), resolve phases timed with `debug_timer!` (packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:77; packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:169); `screenshot` times phases with a `Timer` printing `"{message} in {diff}ms"` (examples/screenshot.rs:186-215; examples/screenshot.rs:56; examples/screenshot.rs:146); `paint_bench` runs 5 warmup iterations (examples/paint_bench.rs:26; examples/paint_bench.rs:39-50); `multi_doc` times its run and, in its `timed_resolve`, each resolve with `Instant::now()` and prints one summary line on stdout with `println!` (examples/multi_doc.rs:61-67; examples/multi_doc.rs:111-115)

subject: crosscut-service-wiring
text: - **Service wiring:** a `shell_provider` handles redraw, clipboard and file dialogs (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:320; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:61; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:928); a `navigation_provider` receives link-click navigations (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:893-897); redraws are requested through `ShellProvider::request_redraw` after mutations, resource loads, hover, device changes and a focus set or cleared, the Tab key asking for none of its own (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:76-78; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:124; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2108; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2288; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1852; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1911-1915); redraw is skipped while critical resources are pending or the window is occluded (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:419-440; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:601-606; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:176-178); dioxus services are provided as root contexts — net provider, HTML parser provider, native document, window event handlers, shell provider, history, renderer, winit window (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:182-206; packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:147-172) — and apps use `use_context_provider` / `use_context` (apps/browser/src/main.rs:121-123; apps/browser/src/tab.rs:211; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:46); the blitz document is shared as `Rc<RefCell<BaseDocument>>` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:70; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/events.rs:140-144); JS shared state is `Rc<RefCell<…>>` in a `DomCtx` on the Boa context (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/state.rs:130-148; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/mod.rs:36-43); window event handlers live in a `SlotMap` applied per window id (packages/dioxus-native/src/event_handlers.rs:25-63; packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:197-199)

subject: crosscut-event-processing
text: - **Event processing:** default-action events are queued and processed in order, each running handlers then its default action unless cancelled (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:352-359; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:423-426); events for sub-documents and custom widgets are forwarded with adjusted coordinates (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:18-27; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:125-180); focused text inputs are re-clamped to keep the caret visible (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:112-123; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:311-318); dioxus skips event kinds with zero handlers (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:326-332; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:349-359); `mounted` listeners fire after `initial_build` and each `poll` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:331-336; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:144-152; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:216-236); JS microtasks drained after eval, timers and event dispatch (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:127-145; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1639; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1690-1692); style and layout resolved before JS geometry, hit-test, selection and computed-style reads (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element.rs:1023-1037; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/document.rs:326-331; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/style.rs:80-84); keyboard shortcuts use Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere (apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:42-56; apps/browser/src/util.rs:4-12)

text: - **Crate purposes:** blitz-html "Blitz HTML parser" (packages/blitz-html/Cargo.toml:3); blitz-net "Blitz networking" (packages/blitz-net/Cargo.toml:3); blitz-paint "Paint a Blitz Document using anyrender" (packages/blitz-paint/Cargo.toml:3); blitz-shell "Blitz application shell" / "Event loop, windowing and system integration." (packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:3; packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:3), whose crate doc lists a hot-reload feature its manifest does not declare (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:8; packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:13-25); blitz-test-harness "Headless test harness for Blitz documents" (packages/blitz-test-harness/Cargo.toml:3); blitz-vibey-script "JavaScript execution for Blitz using the Boa engine" (packages/blitz-vibey-script/Cargo.toml:3), able to run real-world frameworks such as Preact (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/lib.rs:8); blitz-traits "Shared traits and types for Blitz" (packages/blitz-traits/Cargo.toml:3); debug_timer "Utilities for simple timings" (packages/debug_timer/Cargo.toml:3); blitz-dom "Blitz DOM implementation" (packages/blitz-dom/Cargo.toml:3), its layout module meant to "Enable the dom to lay itself out using taffy" (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:1); accesskit_xplat "AccessKit UI accessibility infrastructure: cross-platform adapter" (packages/accesskit_xplat/Cargo.toml:5); Dioxus crates with keywords dom, ui, gui, react and repository `https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:8-10; packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml:8-10), `launch` starting "an interactive HTML/CSS renderer driven by the Dioxus virtualdom" (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:95); `stylo_taffy` keywords css and layout (packages/stylo_taffy/Cargo.toml:5)
